Description: FTK2.ActionPoints default cost model. Roughly preserves vanilla combat pacing: a turn buys one big swing (major) plus a follow-up (minor), same as 1 PA + 1 SA today.

SpdBonus._comment: bonus = min(MaxBonus, floor(SPD / SpdPerPoint)), added to Base at grant time

FocusUsedModifier._comment: Applied to the resolved base cost when CombatDecisionData.FocusUsed is true. Mode: Add | Multiply.

PerCategoryOverrides._comment: Keys are eAbilityCategories values (verified 14-value enum). Overrides beat the Major/Minor default, lose to PerAbilityOverrides.

PerAbilityOverrides._comment: Keys are real Abilities.json ability ids (NOT skill ids). No verified concrete ability id was available in docs/research at spec time -- replace this placeholder with real ids from Abilities.json before shipping. Highest precedence: beats category and major/minor defaults.

LegacyStatConversion._comment: How raw CHANGE_STAT deltas against the legacy Stat=PA/SA (haste/slow, tactics-style passives, scripted phase events) get reinterpreted as AP pool deltas instead of literal int increments. delta_AP = delta_PA * PAPointValue + delta_SA * SAPointValue.

EnemyAP._comment: Symmetric = enemies use the fields above unmodified. Asymmetric = enemies use the Overrides block below (any omitted field falls back to the player-side value above).
